user.title: NEC phone system
user.description: Connects to the SMDR (call log) port of an NEC SL2100 or SV9100. The port is set in Program 10-20 (external equipment 5, SMDR Output); 4001 is the Australian default.

data_description.host: IP address of the phone system's NET port, e.g. 192.168.0.10.
data_description.port: Program 10-20, type 5. Only one program can hold this port at a time.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect. Check the address, that SMDR output is set to LAN (Program 35-01-01) and that no other call logger is connected.

abort.already_configured: This phone system is already set up.

init.title: Rooms and phonebook
init.description: One entry per line as `number: name`. Each extension listed gets its own last-call sensor.

data_description.phonebook: For example `0491570156: Alex`. Used to put names on calls.

error.bad_mapping: Every line needs a colon, like `103: Oliver`.
